message: Astra: Within Fa na’s consultation scene, what can Alex actually respond to in the dialogue you drafted, and what remains only in your plan? Does investigating her use of “review” deserve more attention than the consultation itself? Why would further thought repay its time compared with an informative writing attempt now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make waiting worthwhile? What evidence would distinguish those choices? Could you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and next intention in English, then carry out your chosen step?
